title: Monkey holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 28 62)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 72 62)'/>
  <!-- Left hand -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='6' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <!-- Right hand -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='6' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M50 54 C44 46 34 48 34 55 C34 61 50 70 50 70 C50 70 66 61 66 55 C66 48 56 46 50 54 Z' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M42 52 C40 50 37 51 37 54' stroke='#FF9DB8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='28' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='28' r='3' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='28' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='28' r='3' fill='#D2A06A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#2B1A10'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#2B1A10'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='32' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 42 Q50 46 55 42' stroke='#2B1A10' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#F08A8A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#F08A8A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='88' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M70 78 Q82 78 80 68 Q78 60 72 62' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
